company.name: UDR - Opening Doors to your future

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Supported authorization against security tokens created by Keycloak and JWTs created via in-house solution so that an external client receives important financial data regarding their launched funds via PHP-based sites or Hubspot.

Assisted in deploying client websites built with PHP to Linux-based server clusters using Ansible and Docker to support Infrastructure as Code.

Encrypted passwords for MS SQL Database connections, FTP Servers, APIs and third-party data providers using Vault, and decrypted them safely to support clean deployments of applications in-house.

Implemented integration of a third-party financial data feed asynchronously to ingest data for multiple funds internally, without negatively affecting performance of the data feed itself.

positions.title: IT Student Lab Advisor
positions.description:
•	Provided troubleshooting assistance to the students of the University of Colorado Denver campus regarding various Microsoft Office products and Windows and Mac operating systems
•	Resolved issues regarding high-volume printers that are equipped in the computer labs
•	Assisted students through the school’s printing system, PaperCut
